text: The evidence bundle includes the model response, exact source files, failed requests and verified receipt. Tests cover quotation grounding, access controls and replay protection. A procurement officer study is prepared, but no time saving or money recovered is claimed before real officers measure it. The next step is a consenting procurement unit reviewing one retrospective tender.
